counterfactual_missing_items: Capsule endoscopy performed but images of the diverticula were not captured
No gastrointestinal medical or surgical history
decisive_items: duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency
response.rationale: R4 is directly supported by raw CT evidence of diverticula with adjacent wall thickening, mesenteric edema, and lymphadenopathy, plus follow-up resolution of inflammation, matching acute diverticulitis. R2 relies on family history and lymphadenopathy but lacks chronic mucosal features and is weakened by normal LFTs and no GI history. R1 is contradicted by luminal patency. C1 is a correlated append-only completion of R4 whose only raw span is 'duodenal diverticula' and does not independently supply the inflammatory changes, so it is discounted.

rejected.why: Family history of ulcerative colitis and mesenteric lymphadenopathy are nonspecific; no GI history, normal LFTs, and self-limited inflammatory changes favor diverticulitis over IBD.
Symptoms overlap with obstruction, but 'luminal patency' directly contradicts mechanical obstruction and CT shows inflammation rather than a transition point.

Append-only completion of R4; raw support is only 'duodenal diverticula' and lacks the wall thickening/mesenteric edema needed to establish diverticulitis, so it is discounted as a correlated restatement.
